notes.title: Gangs of Sherwood | Patchnote
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/8c5dd7c4b067b33d9af137bdce740feb491af965.png[/img]

Hi Rebels!

You might have missed it during the holidays, but we applied a patch that contains a lot of improvements, such as a long-awaited Remapping!

[h3][b]See the list of changes below:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Integrated controls remapping.
[*] Added a shortcut in the HUD to quickly open the session list. Only visible in Major Oak, online mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent motion blur from being disabled.
[*] Tweaked Heroic difficulty setting to be more challenging.
[*] A new informative window is displayed upon finishing the game and going back to Major Oak to inform of end-game content.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Invert-Y setting would not be saved upon going back to the title menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where Little John and Friar Tuck could both pick up the same enemy on the ground, creating visual issues.
[*] Improvement to aim assist in certain situations, for example when aiming at something behind the Hero.
[*] Fixed minor visual issues in the end-game arenas.
[*] The Crossbow Guard's aiming laser is now visible to all players in a session.
[*] Fixed a bug where some FX would still play on Heroes on the score screen.
[*] Dodging is now performed when simply pressing the dodge button and doesn't require precise timing.
[*] Fixed gamepad controls not being available when using the keyboard custom controls.
[*] Fixed Little John's Light attacks sometimes triggering the Heat Attack FX while not being a Heat Attack.
[*] Fixed The Rebel Instinct lesson being available before Rebel Instinct is purchased.
[*] Fixed a bug in Larontar Mines where a Hero could land outside the level after a grapple.
[*] Tweaked purchase costs of Techniques to make them purchasable faster.
[*] Fixed a bug where Marian's aiming would rotate sideways when using target lock during aiming.
[*] Fixed the Next Target and Previous Target commands in the remapping UI.
[*] Rebellion Rush FX is visible by all players in the Gang and not only the player who shot it.
[*] Rebel Instinct: now other players see the Rebel Instinct aura of their allies.
[*] Improved the initial lighting on the puppet shows.
[*] Increased cooldown of Marian's daggers and sword when aiming.
[*] Tweaked the damage output of Heroes' light attacks.
[*] Tweaked the overall difficulty of regular enemy units.
[*] Tweaked the overall difficulty of mini-bosses.
[*] Tweaked the stats of some enemies.
[*] Added controller vibrations.
[*] Fixed an audio issue with Edwinstowe's cannon sound sometimes not stopping.
[*] Fixed an issue where some sidequest-related items could be picked up several times.
[*] Added aim assist on several shootable items in the arenas.
[*] Fixed some minor visual issues in the game levels.
[*] Improved how sliders work in the settings screen.
[*] Fixed several issues related to display settings.

[/list]

notes.title: Gangs of Sherwood | First Patch!
notes.content:

Hi everyone, 

Please find below a list of changes that will be already applied when you will start the game on PC:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue when the Ping command would be displayed on Little John 
[*] Improved some visuals in the Fall of Locksley and in Sherwood Forest

[*] Fixed an issue with additional enemies sometimes not spawning correctly during a bos fight

notes.content:

notes.title: Gangs of Sherwood - Beta tutorial
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/13dc92dea1a8cbaea4ad0d5b9d424de7e385401f.png[/img]

Dear Gangs of Sherwood players and friends,
Thank you for your interest and support for the game. Gangs of Sherwood is an online action game that prioritizes cooperative gameplay. This tutorial outlines the basics of online play, and we hope you'll take the time to read it carefully for an enhanced gaming experience.

[h3]How to access Multiplayers Menu 
[/h3] 
Launching the Game: Upon launching the game, you'll land on the selection screen. Click the “Online” button, as multiplayer gameplay is exclusively available online. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/7aedf67cc4b1a5c5c8a982a3a21921607c318355.png[/img]

Character Selection: You'll be redirected to a new screen. Select "Play," choose your desired character, and press “Select,” followed by “Play.” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/0727da36236e779e7eff57434f94540341b4b518.png[/img]

Enter the door and continue upstairs to find the table covered in purple smoke. You are now at the mission selection screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/8f442a77117b5d05a66056bb21e69a3f392197d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/680f3db616c2951fbd6b67d938c92b58ff55b806.png[/img]

[h3]Creating a Public Lobby: 
[/h3]
 
Level Selection: In the level selection menu, choose the desired level. In the "Gang Visibility" tab, select "Public," and click “Start Mission.” Your lobby is now open for anyone to join. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/f80125484ffaaabf0d04160de0a02e82a9284edf.png[/img]

Joining a Random Lobby: 

Finding a Gang: At the bottom right corner of the level selection menu, click “Find Gang.” You'll see open lobbies and the levels being played. Choose one that interests you and click “Yes.” To start the level, move towards the puppeteer and step into the golden circle on the ground. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/68e328bb0594a1a50d669e848ee761f599910966.png[/img]

Inviting a Friend: 

Creating a Lobby: After setting up a lobby, open the pause menu and select the "Social" tab. Click on the “Invite Friend” button at the bottom right of the screen. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/22b252b9bb449344386fa37aa4e5c308eba55c8b.png[/img]

Joining a Friend's Lobby: 

Through Steam: From Steam, click on “YourFriendUsername is playing Gangs of Sherwood” and select "Join Game." To start the level, move towards the puppeteer and enter the golden circle on the ground. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/710acd3996ebcb1807446b8415d9203e3cc6fb44.png[/img]

Leaving a Lobby: 

Lobby Creator: If you created the lobby, open the pause menu, choose the "Social" tab, and click “Disband Gang” at the bottom right of the screen. 
Joining a Lobby: If you didn’t create the lobby, access the pause menu, select the "Exit" tab, and click “Leave Gang.” 

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/0c2cc851ba0a72cab35bbd98b78677134f258968.png[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/30bb53bd109f6cd771ac3c108b265fe421560750.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta Update - List of improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/43d0ed2c46a4f3000d7df256ca589c8fc6ac8023.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

We just operated an update to apply the following changes:

- Added health drops from destructible items
- Fixed Marian sometimes not triggering Flux Thrusts on the host whereas it does client-side
- Updated DLSS plugin to the latest version, now supporting TLAA
- Tweaked Comet arrow visuals for more clarity
- Made some solid objects not affect the camera to reduce unexpected camera movements
- Fixed some minor graphical issues in Kirklees Keep
- Fixed some issues with the Comet arrow shard interacting with other shards
- Fixed Little John's EWGF Shard FX not playing on clients
- Fixed Tuck's whirlwind FX not being interrupted on clients
- Fixed an inconsistency where going back to Mission Selection screen after completing a mission would indicate the wrong difficulty setting
- Improved some Shards-related sound effects
- Fixed Finisher moves cameras sometimes not playing
- Fixed Robin's Heavy Attacks: when performing the heavy attacks and walking backward, Robin would face the camera away from his target

We hope you are having fun playing Gangs of Sherwood and that these changes will make the experience even better!

notes.title: Free Demo: All you need to know
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/b466b1abeb4edf3dd1c0af99efc854e8d19a737d.png[/img]

The much-anticipated Free Demo of Gangs of Sherwood is finally here! Now is the perfect time to delve into the game and explore all the thrilling features waiting for you from October 5th to October 16th.

[u][b]What to Expect in the Demo:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Availability: The Demo will be accessible on Steam starting at 6 PM CEST.
[*] Engage in a short introduction tutorial.
[*] Play Mission 6: Kirklees Keep.
[*] Play as any of the 4 characters, each with unique abilities.
[*] Play solo or team up with friends in cooperative gameplay supporting up to 4 players.
[*] Choose from 3 challenging difficulty levels.
[/list]

[b][u]Why Mission 6?[/u][/b]

You might wonder why we chose Mission 6 specifically. By opting for this mission, we aim to provide you with a glimpse of the game's depth after several missions. Experience the gameplay after unlocking various skills, giving you insight into the exciting skills and combos available as you progress.

[u][b]More Exciting Opportunities:[/b][/u]

But that's not all! We have more in store for you:

[b]Giveaways and Contests: [/b]

[list]
[*] Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/GangsofSherwood]Twitter[/url] and participate in various giveaways and contests throughout the beta for a chance to win up to 4 free Gangs of Sherwood Key.

[*] Join our [url=https://nacon.me/GangsDiscord]Discord[/url] community to connect with fellow players and our team. Engage in Beta challenges to increase your chances of winning a free key for you or your friends.
[/list]

Stay tuned for numerous exciting events  during this Free Demo and Steam Next Fest period. We hope you enjoy your time in Sherwood and have a fantastic time playing Gangs of Sherwood!

notes.title: Alan-a-Dale : Unmasking the Minstrel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/328a65a101effc0bf1a38fded62a5bdb5fe8a3b9.png[/img]

[h2]In the heart of the legendary Sherwood Forest, where tales of valor and chivalry echo through the ages, there lies a character whose story often remains in the shadows, eclipsed by the legendary Robin Hood himself.[/h2]

But as the Major Oak of Sherwood is about to lose its first leaves, it's time to turn the spotlight on the enigmatic figure known as Alan A Dale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/0a502de706a0c5ae1bcdf799b9cc428699115c99.png[/img]

[h2]Honoring the legend: an interesting yet lesser-known figure
[/h2]
Alan, a name that may not ring as loudly as Robin's, conceals a tale as captivating as any epic adventure. He is indeed mentioned in a 17th century ballad, 200 years after the first mentions of Robin Hood. Among the various depictions of Alan, one stands out—an engraving by Louis Rhead, taken from his 1912 book "Bold Robin Hood and His Outlaw Band: Their Famous Exploits in Sherwood Forest."
When crafting Alan's character for Gangs of Sherwood, we drew a lot of inspiration from these enduring legends. Alan embodies the essence of a minstrel, a storyteller and a musician from the European Middle Ages. This is why we dressed him in vibrant attire and portrayed him as a storyteller in Gangs of Sherwood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/d438542d7e75b4998d0fc01266a550c583bada52.png[/img]

[h2]Crafting our own Legend
[/h2]
In the same way that we reinterpreted the legend and the universe of Robin Hood (link to the article) , we allowed ourselves to infuse iconographic elements to Alan-a-Dale’s puppeteer persona.
Among these elements, one finds puppets that are inspired by the “Gignol” theater, and a bell-topped hat decorated with many masks. These elements remind us of the masks of Greek theater, but also of the two-faced god Janus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/52bba67aca2156042fbea966fe74a318c203d911.gif[/img]

[h2]Serving the story: a key character
[/h2]
In fact, just as Janus is the god of beginnings and endings, passage and doors, Alan-a-Dale is a character that you will find at the beginning and end of every level. His duality manifests itself in the narration, because he tells his story both to us as a player, and both to the characters, thus breaking the 4th wall.
Like a feline Cheshire cat, Alan appears at precisely the right moments, physically materializing as the game's "save points."

[h2]To sum things up:
[/h2]
In summary, we trust you've found this blog both intriguing and enlightening. We've relished the opportunity to breathe life into this character and continue to look forward to what lies ahead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/2a55598d9076608f164e26eb5ea59477c0f1e8f8.png[/img]

notes.title: Gangs of Sherwood: A look at the Major Oak
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/7fb86581be02adb1d4d3ad0a99d5576353589669.png[/img]

[h3]My fellow Rebels,

Just a couple more months before the release of Gangs of Sherwood!
[/h3]

We can't wait to finally bring you this epic adventure we've been working on for so long. As I write these lines to you, we are working on the finishing touch  of the game, we are tightening the bows and sharpening the daggers, to offer you the most enjoyable and immersive experience possible.      

Do you recognize the tree in the art above? It is not just any tree.  It represents a centuries-old tree whose roots intertwine with the stones. The most observant may have noticed ruins at its feet, mysterious ruins serving as a refuge for oppressed commoners, and as the headquarters of the nascent rebellion. Inside, a free and reimagined society takes shape, inspired by a new kind of hero, yours.

But that's not the only thing that inspired us: this tree is based on a real one, the Major Oak, which is in the heart of Sherwood Forest, England. 

[h2]The origin of our inspiration, a historic tree with a fascinating story
[/h2]

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Major_Oak#/media/File:Major_Oak_(9494).jpg][img]https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/9b/Major_Oak_%289494%29.jpg/1280px-Major_Oak_%289494%29.jpg[/img][/url]

Allow me to share a little bit of history before we return to slaying those greedy folks.

This humongous tree is thought to weigh more than 20 tons and has a circumference of almost 10 meters. But where do these improbable measurements come from?

While scientists have not reached a definitive conclusion, it is possible that external factors played a role in constraining its growth, much like the deliberate pruning of a bonsai tree. Additionally, there is a hypothesis suggesting that this tree's stunted growth might be due to the merger of several younger trees approximately a century ago.

	Although in the end, its measurements are impressive, you will surely notice that the "real" tree is much smaller than that of our concept art. Let’s dive into these differences!

[h2]Why we adapted and reinvented this tree
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/14337440f3b667dc0935e72fd11684bce3b19682.gif[/img]

Historians agree on the fact that the oldest and most reliable mention of a Robinhood dates to an obscure parchment from 1228. However, the Major Oak is supposed to be between 800 and 1000 years old, so it is very probable that at the time of Robin Hood, this tree was still only a shrub! Therefore, Robin Hood and his companions probably did not shelter there, as the legend tells.

Indeed, as tales and legends do, it is also the job of us creators to not simply repeat stories, but to reinvent them.

As you can see in this gif, we took some liberties to bring our Oak Tree to life. We placed the tree on a small mound, to emphasize its central role. We also chose to represent it in the fall, to showcase it’s bright red foliage through which the sun's rays pierce, making it even more majestic. Finally, we added two long metal pipes, symbolizing the fusion of opposing elements: nature and man’s technology, direct consequences of our steampunk reinterpretation of this timeless legend.
[h3]
From a physical reality to a concept art, from a myth to a video game, we hope you enjoyed this journey with us. We can't wait to tell you more about Gangs of Sherwood and look forward to your discovery of it in just a few months![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625932/2a55598d9076608f164e26eb5ea59477c0f1e8f8.png[/img]
